# Atelier Shreenu

> Refined architecture and interior design for those who live with intention. Bespoke homes and interiors across India by Ranjeet and Shreenu Mukherjee, under The Vrindavan Project.

Atelier Shreenu is an architecture and interior design studio founded in 2025, based in Gurugram, Haryana, India. The studio designs residential, workplace, and hospitality spaces with a focus on material provenance, spatial clarity, and timeless intention. Projects have been featured in Architectural Digest, Elle Decor, and ArchDaily.

## Studio

- [Work](https://ateliershreenu.com/#work): Selected projects across residential and interior design.
- [Approach](https://ateliershreenu.com/#approach): The studio's five-stage process — Consultation, Site Analysis, Concept Design, Detail Development, Execution Guidance.
- [Studio](https://ateliershreenu.com/#studio): About the founders and the practice.
- [Press](https://ateliershreenu.com/#press): Editorial features and publications.
- [Contact](https://ateliershreenu.com/#contact): Enquiries and studio address.

## Journal

- [Blog](https://ateliershreenu.com/blog/): Long-form writing on architecture, interiors, materiality, and craft.
